bilingualCollateral.observation: P3 English reads 'Heart-rate and blood-pressure variability' while the Chinese '心率和血压变异范围' adds 范围 ('range'). The addition is semantically harmless and actually aligns with the sibling's day-5 framing of narrowing HR/BP swings, but the two renderings are not strictly parallel.

Mixed spacing convention in the Chinese strings: a space precedes Latin-script tokens in some places ('按医嘱继续 IVIG', '连续 CSF 蛋白水平') but not others ('连续FVC和MIP趋势', 'SpO2作为'). Purely typographic and consistent with the sibling case's own mixed usage.

Glossary entries in the standalone item carry termEn, termZh, and defZh but no defEn. This matches the sibling case's glossary convention throughout, so it appears to be an intentional format rather than a translation gap; noted only for completeness.

Clinical terminology in the stem translates faithfully in both directions: '进行性四肢轻瘫' for progressive quadriparesis, '血压波动' for labile blood pressure, '单侧咽反射消失' for unilateral absent gag, and all numeric values (FVC 1.6 L / 19 mL/kg, MIP -26 cmH2O) are preserved unchanged. No meaning-altering discrepancy found in any of the eleven token strings or eleven byChoice rationales.

clinicalCollateral.observation: The standalone record's LOW-impact caveat about A2's 'emergent' qualifier is resolved by the sibling: at hour 20 the provider does order emergent intubation, so the token wording is faithful to the case narrative rather than imprecise. The underlying clinical point still stands as a narrow advisory - at hour 16 (FVC 24 mL/kg, MIP -32 cmH2O, 'breathing through a straw', worsening bulbar signs, new left absent gag) many clinicians would have proceeded to controlled intubation before the numbers crossed the stated thresholds. The case is internally consistent because it defines escalation strictly by the FVC <20 / MIP weaker than -30 thresholds; this is a teaching-design choice, not an error.

All FVC/mL-per-kg pairs across the sibling (3.6/42, 3.4/40, 3.1/36, 2.6/31, 2.0/24, 1.6/19, 1.1/13, 0.9/11) are internally consistent with a body weight of approximately 85 kg, even though weight is never stated. The standalone item inherits this consistency, so the actual-versus-ideal-weight ambiguity flagged in the standalone record has no numeric consequence.

The diaphoresis in the standalone stem remains genuinely dual-attributable after unblinding: the sibling attributes it to escalating work of breathing (RR 28 labored, accessory use) and never documents an IVIG infusion reaction. A4's conditional construction ('evaluate ... continue only if it is safe') is therefore correct in both readings and does not require the learner to assume a reaction is occurring. The standalone wording is arguably safer than the sibling's q5 option D, which leads with continuation.

Distractor P4 ('SpO2 alone as the primary respiratory marker') is reinforced by the sibling, where SpO2 is 93% on 2 L at the moment both thresholds are breached - a concrete demonstration of oximetry as a lagging marker. The standalone stem omits SpO2 entirely, which if anything strengthens the item by removing a falsely reassuring number.

Distractor A1 (corticosteroids) is independently addressed in sibling q4 options B and F, and A3 (BiPAP) in sibling q5 option B, with rationales consistent with the standalone item's. No cross-item contradiction was found in the treatment logic.

reasoning: The standalone bow-tie survives unblinding. Every one of the five keyed tokens was classified DIRECT in the immutable standalone record on the strength of stem text alone, and the blind Stage 2 selection (C1 / A2 + A4 / P2 + P3) matched the canonical key exactly without any access to the sibling case. Re-examining each of the nine missing client facts now that the paired case is visible: six of them (numeric vitals, ABG, prior serial FVC/MIP values and interval, days since onset/nadir, telemetry rhythm findings, and the existence of an airway plan) are indeed supplied by the sibling, but in every instance the sibling material is corroborative rather than necessary - each keyed token was already fully triggered by explicit standalone stem text (FVC 19 mL/kg and MIP -26 cmH2O; ineffective cough and unilateral absent gag; labile BP and tachycardia; diaphoresis during active IVIG). Notably the sibling's ABG is drawn post-intubation, so it could not have informed the airway decision even in the full case. Three missing facts (actual versus ideal body weight, full IVIG administration details such as rate/hours elapsed/premedication/prior reactions, and swallow screen/cough peak flow/chest imaging/code status) remain absent from the sibling as well, confirming they were never load-bearing for the key. No keyed token requires a case-only threshold: although the sibling states provider thresholds of FVC <20 mL/kg or MIP weaker than -30 cmH2O, these are the standard 20/30/40 criteria available as general nursing knowledge, so A2 does not depend on hidden case content. All six distractors remain CONTRADICTED on standalone grounds. There is therefore no hidden case dependency, no unsupported token premise, no underdetermination, and no key or logic error. Remaining observations are narrow and cosmetic, warranting only an advisory P3.

scopeCollateral.observation: Token text overlap: A2 is verbatim identical to sibling q5 option A, and A3 is a close paraphrase of sibling q5 option B ('Initiate BiPAP as the preferred substitute for intubation because he is still awake'). A4 is a reworded and re-emphasized version of sibling q5 option D. This indicates the bow-tie pool was derived from the sibling's take-action SATA item. It does not create a dependency - the standalone stem carries its own evidence for every token - but it means a learner who has completed the sibling case would recognize the options.

Pool coverage gap noted in the standalone record is confirmed: the sibling's q5 includes option C (suction, oxygen, IV access, RSI readiness, continuous monitoring), the closest analogue to the aspiration/airway-protection action that blind Stage 1 free-generated as its second priority. The bow-tie pool omits any such token, so the standalone item cannot reward that reasoning path. A4 remains the correct and defensible second action; this is an option-set coverage observation, not a key defect.

The bow-tie's 'as ordered' phrasing in A4 is inferable standalone from 'while receiving IVIG in the ICU' (an infusion in progress implies a standing order) and is explicitly confirmed by the sibling order set (IVIG 0.4 g/kg/day for 5 days). No learner is required to import the sibling order to select A4.

The standalone item's testTakingStrategy ('identify the central threat first, then pick actions that reduce it and monitoring that tracks it') is self-contained and does not reference case stages, exhibits, or provider orders, keeping the item usable outside the case context.
